privacySection1Body: Izina ryawe, numero ya telefoni, imeyili, aho uri neza igihe usaba cyangwa ufite urugendo, amateka y'ingendo n'amakuru yo kwishyura.
privacySection2Body: Kugira ngo dufungure konti, dukubona umushoferi, dukurikirane ingendo ziriho, dukemure kwishyura no gutanga ubufasha. Ntabwo dugurisha amakuru bwite.
privacySection3Body: Amakuru y'ingenzi ku rugendo (aho gutangirira, aho ugana, inzira) asangirwa n'umushoferi wemeye urugendo rwawe. Amakuru ntasangirwa n'abandi ku mpamvu z'ubwamamazi.
privacySection4Body: Aho uri neza hakoreshwa mu gihe cy'urugendo ruriho cyangwa igihe ushakisha aho gutangirira. Ntibikurikiranwa mu buryo budasa n'ubufatanye.
privacySection5Body: Amakuru y'ingendo abikwa mu mezi 12 kandi ushobora gusaba kubona cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe bwite igihe cyose uvugana n'ubufasha.
privacySection6Body: Amakuru yoherezwa mu buryo bwizewe kandi abikwa hakurikijwe uburenganzira bugenwa. Ufite inshingano yo kubika amakuru yo kwinjira ari uko ari.
privacySection7Body: Twandikire ku bibazo by'ibanga binyuze kuri imeyili. Imeyili yacu y'ubufasha igaragara munsi ya Ubufasha n'inkunga.

subject: Ingingo
supportResponse: Twohereze ubutumwa — itsinda ryacu risubiza mu masaha 24.
termsSection1Body: Mu gufungura konti cyangwa gukoresha FEM C@BS wemeranya n'aya mabwiriza yo gukoresha na politiki yacu y'ibanga. Niba utabyemeranyaho, ntukoreshe iyi porogaramu. Aya mabwiriza aracyari umushinga kugeza igihe azasozwa mbere yo gutangira.
termsSection2Body: FEM C@BS itanga serivisi zo gutwara abagenzi. Umugenzi agomba kuba afite byibura imyaka 18. Konti ni iz'umuntu ku giti cye, amakuru yawe agomba kuba ari ay'ukuri, kandi ntugomba gukoresha nabi porogaramu cyangwa gucengera abandi bakoresha.
termsSection3Body: Ibiciro by'ingendo bigaragazwa mbere yo gufata urugendo bishingiye ku ntera. Amafaranga y'ukuri ashobora gutandukana igihe sisitemu nyayo y'ibiciro izahurizwa. Ushobora guhagarika mbere y'uko umushoferi yemera; politiki yo guhagarika izagaragazwa igihe izatangira gukurikizwa.
termsSection4Body: Kwishyura birasabwa kuri buri rugendo rurangiye. Uburyo bwemewe bugaragazwa igihe wafataga urugendo. Amafaranga adishyuwe ashobora kubuza izindi ngendo kugeza igihe azishyurwa.
termsSection5Body: Ufite inshingano ku bikorwa byose biba kuri konti yawe. Niba ukeka ko hari uwakoresheje konti yawe atabifitiye uburenganzira, hita uvugana n'ubufasha. Dushobora guhagarika konti zirenga aya mabwiriza.
termsSection6Body: Mu rwego rushobotse rwemewe n'amategeko, FEM C@BS ntizabazwa ku byangiritse bitaziguye cyangwa bitunguranye. Ingendo zitangwa n'abashoferi bigenga bari kuri urubuga icyo gihe.
termsSection7Body: Dushobora kuvugurura aya mabwiriza igihe cyose. Amabwiriza mashya azaboneka muri porogaramu kandi azakurikizwa akimara gusohoka.
